trigger: External Chrome recording preserved a non-terminal Queen workflow and a committee button without visible feedback.

fixes.behavior: Queen workflow now exposes running, succeeded, error, and cancelled states, the active node, a user cancellation action, and a 45-second deadline for each GraphQL operation.
Declare no conflict now changes to an acknowledged local-only state and explicitly says that no vote or blockchain transaction was submitted.

verification.command: pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/pages/LocalAgentsPage.test.tsx src/pages/ControlPages.test.tsx

truthBoundary: The original recording remains unchanged evidence of the pre-fix observation.
A timeout or cancellation is an explicit terminal UI state, not a successful Agent result.
The committee acknowledgement is browser-local demo feedback and is not an on-chain vote or ruling.
